title: Avoid aggregate extraction name display allocation
description: Classify aggregate function names with direct ObjectNamePart matching before extracting aggregates.

criteria: Non-aggregate function expressions no longer allocate an uppercase display name during aggregate extraction
Aggregate names still record the same uppercase accumulator names
Qualified names remain rejected by the simple built-in aggregate check

notes: The extractor now asks aggregate_function_name for a static aggregate accumulator name.
The effective aggregate String is allocated only when a new aggregate is recorded.
Non-aggregate functions recurse into arguments without allocating an ObjectName display string or uppercase String.
